{{Quote|You! So you... uhhh! You made after all. I hoped your head would be Nalen's trophy by now.|Wounded Twi'lek to a padawan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Gender|male]] '''Twi'lek''' lived on the world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] as a member of the Twi'lek Pilgrims that chose to colonize this world. At some point during the final year of the war, this Twi'lek wanted to prove himself to [[Nalen Raloch]] when he entered the [[Fount of Rajivari]], but was badly wounded from the traps he faced.
